_comment: SiliconFlow keeps a handful of smaller open-source models permanently free. The binding limit is REQUESTS PER DAY, not tokens: 50/day on an account with no purchased credit, ~1000/day once at least 10 credits have been bought. Note the international platform is siliconflow.com; the .cn platform requires a Chinese phone number to register. Every entry ships DISABLED — the free roster rotates, so run ./scripts/test-all-providers.ps1 and enable only what answers.
